description: Android activity class 'Signature' handling signature capture, image capture, and upload for a delivery job in the app.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Android activity for capturing signatures, taking photos, uploading images, and updating delivery job status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and event listeners.

methods.name: createImageFromSignature
methods.description: Creates an image from the signature drawing and initiates upload.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Launches camera intent to take a photo.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from camera activity and loads the captured image.

methods.name: uploadBitmap
methods.description: Uploads a bitmap image to the server via Volley multipart request.

methods.name: getFileDataFromDrawable
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap to byte array for upload.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Updates job record with image URLs and delivery status.

methods.name: callUpdateDatabase
methods.description: Prepares image names and calls updateDatabase.

methods.name: createTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file for storing captured images.

methods.name: grabImage
methods.description: Loads image from URI, resizes, and sets to ImageView.
